ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed ProcDump Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of a renamed ProcDump executable.
This often done by attackers or malware in order to evade defensive mechanisms.

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "procdump" OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ma\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-mp\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/accepteula.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\procdump\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procdump64\\\.exe$")))
